messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000909" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, having taken it over from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000902": As of 2025-12-19, the product catalog's dashboards and alerts are being repointed as part of the handover to the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, product catalog, dashboards, alerts)
- memory_id "1000619" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the catalog service (product catalog) deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000331": In the catalog service, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000929": On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team noticed that feature-flags' queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it, as it is not their service.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000335" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000917": On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it is not their service, they flagged it.  (about: Atlas team, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000899" [decision]: Decision on 2025-12-18: the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000713" [preference]: As of 2025-09-30, the Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000750": As of 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000933" [decision]: As of 2026-01-12, the billing API belongs to the Ember team, having been run by the Atlas team until then.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000729": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000818" [decision]: As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the event bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000831": As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer's dashboards and alerts are being repointed.  (about: image resizer)
- memory_id "1000733" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder, having transferred from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000827" [decision]: As of 2025-11-26, the Atlas team owns the image resizer, having taken it over from the Ember team.  (about: Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000833": As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, having previously been owned by the Ember team.  (about: Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000154": The search indexer relies on the catalog service for product documents, so if the catalog service is down, the search indexer is down.  (about: indexer, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000783" [decision]: As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, having been run by the Atlas team until then.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team)
Existing entity names: Atlas team, Cinder, product catalog, dashboards, alerts, catalog service, feature-flags, the bus, reports pipeline, indexer, image resizer, billing API, Ember team, ledger service, Boreal team, Priya Raman, Tomasz

[2026-01-22] standup/atlas/2026-01-22: The product catalog deploy window (unchanged): on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
